industry: Independent Power and Renewable Electricity Producers
name: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk
summary: PT Pertamina Geothermal Energy Tbk, a subsidiary of PT Pertamina Power Indonesia, was established in 2006 and maintains its headquarters in Central Jakarta, Indonesia. This company, alongside its various affiliates, specializes in harnessing and developing geothermal energy resources. Its operations encompass the full spectrum of the geothermal industry, from initial exploration and production (upstream) to power generation and distribution (downstream), with activities spanning both domestic markets within Indonesia and international ventures.
